commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' Las Palmas fail to score from a corner as Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) leaps to collect the ball.
90+3' The ratio of the ball possession is 32:68.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

89' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Vicente Guaita inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
85' It will be a substitution. Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is ready to enter the pitch as Carles Perez walks off.
85' One of the players from Celta Vigo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

83' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
81' That will be all from Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Daley Sinkgraven.
79' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pejino (Las Palmas) replacing Maximo Perrone.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Munir El Haddadi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas).
78' It is time for a substitution. Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is on for Iago Aspas.
78' Substitution. Fran Beltran leaves the pitch and is replaced by Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo).

76' 4 - 1 Anastasios Douvikas sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 4:1.
75' Some neat passing and movement from Las Palmas as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
71' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Iago Aspas tees up Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Alvaro Valles.
67' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Jorgen Strand Larsen and he is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Williot Swedberg will be replaced by Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
66' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card.
62' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Enzo Loiodice is replaced by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
62' Substitution. Sory Kaba will be replaced by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas).
62' The number of shots on goal at present is 11:2.
58' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
53' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.

53' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alvaro Valles sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
50' The goalkeeper dives to deny Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. Celta Vigo have a corner.
50' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) for Sergi Cardona.
50' A great solo run by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Alvaro Valles.
48' Some patient build-up play from Las Palmas as they look to unlock the defence.
46' Referee Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' The ball possession is 36:64.
45' Las Palmas control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
39' 2 - 1 Goal! Iago Aspas plays a long ball to Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:1.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.

36' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Alvaro Valles makes a great save to stop his effort. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.

34' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Las Palmas win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
25' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
24' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
24' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Celta Vigo get a corner.
23' The linesman signals that Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
21' The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.
21' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball. Las Palmas will take a corner kick.
18' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

16' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Las Palmas, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
16' Great teamplay by Las Palmas as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

11' 0 - 1 Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
11' The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner.

10' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alvaro Valles with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Las Palmas.
7' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

4' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
3' The referee blows his whistle, Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
3' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) is flagged for offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is the one to supervise the game today.
